Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must discontinue all hypertensive therapy two weeks prior to entering this study.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient with a serum cholesterol value of 240 mg/dl or greater.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient's LDL cholesterol is 190 mg/dL, which is below the 240 mg/dL threshold.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must discontinue all lipid-lowering agents 1 month prior to entering this study.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is currently on atorvastatin, a lipid-lowering agent, and has not discontinued it prior to study entry.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: No history of diabetes, peripheral vascular disease, coagulopathy, or any other disease predisposing to vasculitis or Raynaud's phenomenon.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has a documented history of Type 2 diabetes mellitus.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: No women with childbearing potential unless they use an effective contraceptive method.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is male and does not apply to this criterion.
